nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.dixon_heatmap¶

Dixon QC: measurement heatmap inside segmentation masks.

Per-ROI axial slice stacks with a range slider (same interaction model as slice views): - Outside masks: Dixon WATER sequence (grayscale underlay, same as slice views). - Inside mask: FF or T2 metric as a heatmap overlay.

Functions¶

build_dixon_measurement_heatmap_html(→ str)

Return embeddable HTML with per-ROI axial slice scrolling for FF and T2.
